requirements.quote:
Certificate:  The certificate of the endpoint and any per-certificate
      extensions.
requirements.condition: when an endpoint sends a certificate-based Certificate message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: substitute a certificate for a different endpoint
requirements.why_checkable: The Certificate message can be decoded and compared with the sending endpoint's configured credential.

requirements.quote:
Certificate:  The certificate of the endpoint and any per-certificate
      extensions.
requirements.condition: when per-certificate extensions apply
requirements.required_behavior: associate those extensions with the corresponding certificate entry in the Certificate message
requirements.why_checkable: Each CertificateEntry can be decoded and checked for its own extension vector.

requirements.quote:
This message is omitted by the server if not
      authenticating with a certificate
requirements.condition: when the server is not authenticating with a certificate
requirements.why_checkable: Non-certificate server-authentication traces can be checked for absence of Certificate.

requirements.quote:
and by the client if the server
      did not send CertificateRequest
requirements.condition: when the server did not send CertificateRequest
requirements.why_checkable: Client handshake output can be checked for Certificate only after a CertificateRequest.

requirements.quote:
if raw
      public keys [RFC7250] or the cached information extension
      [RFC7924] are in use, then this message will not contain a
      certificate
requirements.condition: when raw public keys or the cached information extension are in use
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode a certificate in the Certificate message
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate-message contents can be decoded under the negotiated raw-key or cached-information mode.

requirements.quote:
but rather some other value corresponding to the
      server's long-term key.
requirements.condition: when raw public keys or the cached information extension are in use for the server
requirements.required_behavior: encode the applicable value corresponding to the server's long-term key in the Certificate message
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded value can be compared with the server's configured long-term public-key material.

requirements.quote:
CertificateVerify:  A signature over the entire handshake using the
      private key corresponding to the public key in the Certificate
      message.
requirements.condition: when an endpoint sends CertificateVerify
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sign only a subset or a transcript inconsistent with the handshake
requirements.why_checkable: CertificateVerify can be verified against the complete transcript and rejected after transcript mutation.

requirements.quote:
CertificateVerify:  A signature over the entire handshake using the
      private key corresponding to the public key in the Certificate
      message.
requirements.condition: when an endpoint sends CertificateVerify
requirements.required_behavior: use the private key corresponding to the public key in its Certificate message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sign CertificateVerify with a key inconsistent with the Certificate message
requirements.why_checkable: CertificateVerify signature validation directly checks the key-to-certificate correspondence.

requirements.quote:
This message is omitted if the endpoint is not
      authenticating via a certificate.
requirements.condition: when the endpoint is not authenticating via a certificate
requirements.why_checkable: Non-certificate authentication traces can be checked for absence of CertificateVerify.

requirements.quote:
Finished:  A MAC (Message Authentication Code) over the entire
      handshake.
requirements.condition: when constructing Finished
requirements.required_behavior: compute the MAC over the entire handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: authenticate an incomplete or inconsistent handshake transcript
requirements.why_checkable: Finished test vectors and transcript mutation tests can verify the MAC input.

requirements.quote: This message provides key confirmation,
requirements.condition: when validating Finished
requirements.required_behavior: confirm possession of the derived handshake key
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept Finished without valid key confirmation
requirements.why_checkable: Finished validation can be tested with a peer using incorrect derived key material.

requirements.quote:
binds the
      endpoint's identity to the exchanged keys,
requirements.condition: when certificate-based endpoint identity is used
requirements.required_behavior: bind the endpoint's authenticated identity to the exchanged keys through Finished
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept a Finished value associated with a different identity or key exchange
requirements.why_checkable: Credential and key-exchange substitutions can be tested to ensure Finished validation fails.

requirements.quote:
in PSK mode also
      authenticates the handshake.
requirements.condition: when the handshake uses PSK mode
requirements.required_behavior: use Finished to authenticate the handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: complete the PSK handshake with an invalid Finished authentication value
requirements.why_checkable: PSK handshakes can be tested with altered transcripts and Finished values.

requirements.quote:
Upon receiving the server's messages, the client responds with its
   Authentication messages,
requirements.condition: after the client receives the server's handshake messages
requirements.required_behavior: respond with the client's Authentication messages
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send the client Authentication flight before receiving the server's messages
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake traces can verify the transition and ordering between server and client authentication flights.

requirements.quote:
namely Certificate and CertificateVerify (if
   requested), and Finished.
requirements.condition: when the server requested certificate-based client authentication
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit the requested client Certificate message
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake trace can check Certificate presence after a certificate-authentication request.

requirements.quote:
namely Certificate and CertificateVerify (if
   requested), and Finished.
requirements.condition: when the server requested certificate-based client authentication and the client authenticates with a certificate
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit the requested client CertificateVerify message
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake trace can check CertificateVerify presence after the requested client Certificate.

requirements.quote:
namely Certificate and CertificateVerify (if
   requested), and Finished.
requirements.condition: when the client sends its Authentication flight
requirements.why_checkable: Client authentication-flight parsing can verify that Finished terminates the flight.

requirements.quote:
namely Certificate and CertificateVerify (if
   requested), and Finished.
requirements.condition: when the client sends Certificate and CertificateVerify
requirements.why_checkable: The client authentication message sequence can be asserted directly from a handshake trace.

requirements.quote:
namely Certificate and CertificateVerify (if
   requested), and Finished.
requirements.condition: when the client sends CertificateVerify
requirements.why_checkable: The client authentication message sequence can be asserted directly from a handshake trace.

requirements.quote: At this point, the handshake is complete,
requirements.condition: after the client sends its Finished message in the full handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: mark the full handshake complete before this point
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake state can be observed immediately before and after the client's Finished message.

requirements.quote:
the client and server
   derive the keying material required by the record layer to exchange
   application-layer data protected through authenticated encryption.
requirements.condition: when the full handshake reaches completion
requirements.required_behavior: derive the record-layer keying material for authenticated encryption of application data
requirements.why_checkable: Both peers' post-handshake traffic secrets and authenticated-encryption records can be compared with key-schedule vectors.

requirements.quote:
Application Data MUST NOT be sent prior to sending the Finished
   message, except as specified in Section 2.3.
requirements.condition: except for the early-data case specified in Section 2.3
requirements.required_behavior: send Finished before sending Application Data
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send Application Data before sending Finished
requirements.why_checkable: Record traces can assert the relative order of Finished and Application Data, with an explicit 0-RTT exception.
